title: CadenceTracker — onset intervals, median estimate, release constraint
description:
Implement Source/DSP/CadenceTracker as a real-time-safe Riff Cadence Engine unit that estimates recent onset spacing and constrains adaptive release so the gate can close before the next expected attack without tempo quantization.

Before editing, inspect:
- .abracapocus/CHUGGATE_SPEC.md section 11 (onset interval estimate, release constraint, controls)
- Source/DSP/AttackGuard.* and Source/DSP/PerformanceStateMachine.* for onset/attack event surfaces cadence will consume later
- Source/DSP/SustainAnalyzer.* adaptive-release API patterns from phase D
- Existing Source/DSP/ header style (prepare/reset/process, realtime-safe fixed storage)
- Source/ParameterIDs.h for any cadence/release-related IDs if present

Implement CadenceTracker.h/.cpp per spec §11:
- Accept onset/attack event times (sample timestamps or block-local flags with running sample counter). Maintain a fixed-length circular history of recent inter-onset intervals:
  delta_i = t_i - t_{i-1}
- Robust interval estimate I = median of the most recent k valid deltas; reject outliers (e.g. drop intervals outside a ratio band of the current median or absolute clamps for musically plausible pick rates).
- Release constraint (does not quantize playing):
  tau_release_max = c * I with c in [0.15, 0.85] (settable)
  tau_release_eff = min(tau_manual, tau_release_max)
  Expose getIntervalSeconds(), getReleaseConstraintSeconds(), getEffectiveRelease(tau_manual), and a confidence/validity flag when history is insufficient.
- Controls / mode: Audio cadence, Host tempo, Combined, Off. Host-tempo path may accept BPM + subdivision factory defaults without owning transport plumbing in the processor yet. Off bypasses constraint (return tau_manual unchanged).
- prepare(sampleRate)/reset(); process or noteOnset()/tick APIs must be allocation-free on the audio path. Fixed-capacity interval buffer only.

Do NOT implement NoiseFloorEstimator, AlignmentAnalyzer, or FractionalDelay. Do NOT edit PluginProcessor or CMakeLists.txt (e.4 owns integration). Do NOT write tests (e.5).

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY the files listed in this task's allowed_write_paths.
acceptance_criteria: CadenceTracker records inter-onset intervals delta_i = t_i - t_{i-1} in fixed-capacity storage
CadenceTracker computes robust median interval I from recent deltas with outlier rejection
CadenceTracker implements tau_release_max = c * I (c in [0.15, 0.85]) and tau_release_eff = min(tau_manual, tau_release_max)
CadenceTracker supports cadence modes Audio, Host tempo, Combined, and Off
No heap allocation in the per-block / onset-process path
No file outside the task's allowed_write_paths is created or modified

allowed: use plain C++20 + JUCE types already in the project
fixed-size circular interval history owned by CadenceTracker
accept onset flags/timestamps and optional host BPM as inputs
forbidden: implement MIDI clock / host transport ownership
quantize note timing or force tempo grid snap
